title: 第1929章 小金的战力第1928章 斗兽场
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 斗兽场很宏大，秦易扫了一眼，几乎百分之九十的修行者，都汇聚在中间最大的斗兽台周围。
“就这里了。”
小金自告奋勇，带着秦易走到了这座最大的斗兽台前。
吼！
斗兽台上，有两头体型庞大的妖兽正在战斗，其中一头妖兽跟小金还是同源，也是一头豹子。
只不过，它是最普通的豹族，没有小金这种上古超级神兽血脉。
轰隆隆！
震耳欲聋的声音，响彻斗兽场，两头体型庞大的妖兽，狠狠的撕咬在一起，它们每一次攻击，都会在对方的肉身之上，留下一道道的伤痕。
撕啦！
大约过了一刻钟的时间，那头豹子力竭，被另外一头妖兽抓住机会，直接一爪子将豹子的腿抓伤，而后可怕的造化之力，狠狠的轰击在了豹子身上。
咔嚓！
豹子倒在地上，奄奄一息。
就在所有人都以为，战斗就此结束的时候，那头获胜的妖兽居然张开血盆大口，直接一口将豹子吞吃。
吼！
豹子发出了强烈的不甘，可技不如人，在斗兽台上失败的下场，有可能就是付出生命的代价。
咔嚓！
这头获胜的妖兽，三两下就把豹子的身体咬碎，吞服腹中。
吼！
它仰天长啸，大声嘶吼，在宣泄着自己胜利的喜悦。
而此刻。
在斗兽台的另一边，一位身穿白色衣袍的男子，脸色铁青，内心无比痛苦。
眼睁睁看着自己的伙伴被杀，他却无能为力。
“刘少，还要继续吗？”
就在这时，他身后传来了一道笑声。
哼！
被称之为刘少的男子，冷哼一声，转身离开。
“恭喜李少。”
“李少的这头妖兽，真是厉害。”
“恐怕造化境中，也难寻敌手吧。”
一群人都在恭维获胜妖兽的主人李少。
李少脸上露出了骄傲的神情，他目光扫过众人，而后霸气说道：“还有人要挑战我的妖兽吗？不管什么筹码，我全部都接。”
虽然被杀的豹子，与小金没有任何关系，但毕竟也算是同源。
小金内心怒火中烧，看向斗兽台上的那头妖兽，充满了怒火。
秦易突然站出来，走到李少面前。
笑着问道：“不知道我是否可以挑战？”
李少瞥了秦易一眼，发现他很陌生，他冷冷说道：“想要挑战我，必须要有足够多的造化天珠，否则的话……”
content_en:
The Colosseum was very grand. Qin Yi glanced at it and saw that almost 90% of the practitioners were gathered around the largest arena in the middle.
"That's it."
Xiao Jin volunteered and led Qin Yi to the largest beast fighting stage.
roar!
On the beast fighting stage, there were two huge monsters fighting. One of the monsters had the same origin as Xiao Jin, and was also a leopard.
However, it is the most ordinary leopard clan and does not have the bloodline of an ancient super beast like Xiao Jin.
Boom!
A deafening sound resounded throughout the Colosseum as the two huge monsters bit each other fiercely. Every time they attacked, they would leave scars on each other's bodies.
Tear it apart!
About a quarter of an hour later, the leopard was exhausted. Another monster seized the opportunity and directly scratched the leopard's leg with a claw, and then the terrifying power of creation struck the leopard hard.
Click!
The leopard fell to the ground, dying.
Just when everyone thought the battle was over, the victorious beast opened its bloody mouth and swallowed the leopard in one bite.
roar!
The leopard expressed strong dissatisfaction, but his skills were inferior to those of others. Failure in the beast fighting arena might cost him his life.
Click!
The victorious monster bit the leopard's body into pieces in a few strokes and swallowed it whole.
roar!
It looked up to the sky and roared loudly, venting the joy of its victory.
And at this moment.
On the other side of the fighting platform, there was a man in white robes, his face was ashen, and his heart was in great pain.
He watched helplessly as his comrades were killed and there was nothing he could do.
"Master Liu, do you want to continue?"
At this moment, a laugh came from behind him.
snort!
The man called Mr. Liu snorted coldly and turned to leave.
"Congratulations, Mr. Li."
"Master Li's monster is really powerful."
"I'm afraid it's hard to find an opponent in the realm of creation."
A group of people were complimenting Mr. Li, the master of the victorious monster.
There was a proud look on Mr. Li's face. He glanced at everyone, and then said domineeringly: "Is there anyone else who wants to challenge my monster? No matter what the chips are, I will take them all."
Although the leopard that was killed had nothing to do with Xiao Jin, it was still of the same origin.
Xiaojin was filled with anger, and looked at the monster on the beast fighting stage, full of anger.
Qin Yi suddenly stood up and walked to Mr. Li.
He smiled and asked, "I wonder if I can challenge you?"
Young Master Li glanced at Qin Yi and found that he was unfamiliar. He said coldly: "If you want to challenge me, you must have enough Fortune Beads, otherwise..."
